description: Potentiel hydroélectrique des tronçons de cours d'eau sur Rhône-Alpes is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by catalogue.datara.gouv.fr. DREAL Rhône-Alpes has commissioned the CETTE de Lyon to study the hydroelectric potential of the Rhône-Alpes region with regard to environmental issues in order to feed into a strategic reflection aimed at reconciling two ambitious environmental objectives: -combating greenhouse gases by increasing the share of renewable energy, including hydroelectricity, -achieve the objectives of “good ” ... Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Hydroelectric potential of watercourse sections on Rhône-Alpes" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Lieux de production et sites industriels, Sources d'énergie, Données vecteur. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
